summary_en: RECOMM to acquire 100% of Tomiya Co., Ltd. (Akita, office supplies and equipment distributor, founded 1797) via two-stage transaction: stock purchase for controlling stake (September 4, 2026) followed by simplified share exchange for remaining shares (September 7, 2026). Consideration partly in cash and partly in RECOMM shares (no new issuance; treasury shares used). Akita shareholder to retain ownership position post-closing.
summary_jp: レカムが秋田県の文具・事務用機器卸商社・とみや100%を取得。二段階方式：株式譲渡で過半数取得（9月4日予定）、簡易株式交換で完全子会社化（9月7日予定）。対価は現金及びレカム株式（自己株式充当、新株発行なし）。秋田の大株主は取得後も株主として継続。
